import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"lr": 0.001, "n_envs": 128, "rollout_len": 16, "n_minibatches": 8, "ppo_epochs": 2, "ent_coef": 0.005}

STEM = 64
COL = 48
WIDTH = 40
PROJ = 32
HID = 32


class PoolHead(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, footprints, proj, hid):
        super().__init__()
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in footprints]
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(c, proj, 1)
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(3 * proj, hid, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(hid, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])

    def forward(self, f):
        p = self.proj(f)
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix, out in zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.outs):
            if dy * dx == 1:
                mx, mn, av = p, p, p
            else:
                q = F.pad(p, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            h = F.relu(mix(torch.cat([mx, mn, av], dim=1)))
            res.append(out(h))
        return torch.cat(res, dim=1).flatten(1)


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(spec.in_channels, STEM, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(STEM, COL, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(COL, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.head = PoolHead(WIDTH, spec.footprints, PROJ, HID)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * WIDTH, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        s = self.stem(obs)
        x = F.relu(self.c1(s))
        f = F.relu(x + self.c2(x))
        place = self.head(f)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"lr": 0.001, "n_envs": 128, "rollout_len": 16, "n_minibatches": 8, "ppo_epochs": 2, "ent_coef": 0.005}

HID = 40
TR = 24
PROJ = 16
MIX = 16
GH = 64


def foot_pool(p, dy, dx):
    if dy * dx == 1:
        return torch.cat([p, p, p], dim=1)
    q = F.pad(p, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
    mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
    mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
    av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
    return torch.cat([mx, mn, av], dim=1)


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.Z = int(spec.Z)
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in spec.footprints]
        C = int(spec.in_channels)
        Z = self.Z
        self.register_buffer("zemb", torch.eye(Z))
        self.trunk = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(C, TR, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(TR, TR, 3, padding=1), nn.ReLU())
        cin = 12 + C + Z + TR
        self.s1 = nn.Conv2d(cin, HID, 1)
        self.s2 = nn.Conv2d(HID, HID, 1)
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(HID, PROJ, 1)
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(3 * PROJ, MIX, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(MIX, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * HID + 2 * TR, GH), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(GH, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(GH, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        B, C, Y, X = obs.shape
        Z = self.Z
        t = self.trunk(obs)
        local = torch.stack([obs[:, 0:Z], obs[:, Z:2 * Z], obs[:, 2 * Z:3 * Z], obs[:, 3 * Z:4 * Z]], dim=2)
        padded = F.pad(local, (0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 1, 1))
        below = padded[:, 0:Z]
        above = padded[:, 2:Z + 2]
        g = obs.unsqueeze(1).expand(B, Z, C, Y, X)
        zc = self.zemb.view(1, Z, Z, 1, 1).expand(B, Z, Z, Y, X)
        tc = t.unsqueeze(1).expand(B, Z, t.shape[1], Y, X)
        x = torch.cat([local, below, above, g, zc, tc], dim=2).reshape(B * Z, -1, Y, X)
        h = F.relu(self.s1(x))
        h = F.relu(h + self.s2(h))
        p = self.proj(h)
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix, out in zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.outs):
            u = F.relu(mix(foot_pool(p, dy, dx)))
            res.append(out(u))
        s = torch.cat(res, dim=1).view(B, Z, len(self.fps), Y, X)
        place = torch.logsumexp(s, dim=1).flatten(1)
        hz = h.view(B, Z, HID, Y, X)
        feat = torch.cat([hz.mean((1, 3, 4)), hz.amax((1, 3, 4)), t.mean((2, 3)), t.amax((2, 3))], dim=1)
        gg = self.glob(feat)
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(gg)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(gg).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

import math
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"lr": 0.001, "n_envs": 128, "rollout_len": 32, "n_minibatches": 32, "ppo_epochs": 2, "ent_coef": 0.005, "gamma": 0.98, "gae_lambda": 0.95}

D = 48
HEADS = 4
FF = 96
PROJ = 32
HID = 32
GH = 64


class PoolHead(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, footprints, proj, hid):
        super().__init__()
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in footprints]
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(c, proj, 1)
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(3 * proj, hid, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(hid, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])

    def forward(self, f):
        p = self.proj(f)
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix, out in zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.outs):
            if dy * dx == 1:
                mx, mn, av = p, p, p
            else:
                q = F.pad(p, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            h = F.relu(mix(torch.cat([mx, mn, av], dim=1)))
            res.append(out(h))
        return torch.cat(res, dim=1).flatten(1)


class Block(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, d, heads, ff):
        super().__init__()
        self.heads = heads
        self.n1 = nn.LayerNorm(d)
        self.qkv = nn.Linear(d, 3 * d)
        self.o = nn.Linear(d, d)
        self.n2 = nn.LayerNorm(d)
        self.f1 = nn.Linear(d, ff)
        self.f2 = nn.Linear(ff, d)

    def forward(self, x):
        B, N, Dm = x.shape
        hd = Dm // self.heads
        qkv = self.qkv(self.n1(x)).view(B, N, 3, self.heads, hd).permute(2, 0, 3, 1, 4)
        q, k, v = qkv.unbind(0)
        a = torch.softmax(torch.matmul(q, k.transpose(-1, -2)) / math.sqrt(hd), dim=-1)
        y = torch.matmul(a, v).transpose(1, 2).reshape(B, N, Dm)
        x = x + self.o(y)
        x = x + self.f2(F.relu(self.f1(self.n2(x))))
        return x


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        C = int(spec.in_channels)
        N = int(spec.Y) * int(spec.X)
        self.inp = nn.Linear(C, D)
        self.pos = nn.Parameter(torch.randn(1, N, D) * 0.02)
        self.blocks = nn.ModuleList([Block(D, HEADS, FF) for _ in range(2)])
        self.nf = nn.LayerNorm(D)
        self.head = PoolHead(D, spec.footprints, PROJ, HID)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * D, GH), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(GH, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(GH, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        B, C, Y, X = obs.shape
        t = obs.flatten(2).transpose(1, 2)
        h = self.inp(t) + self.pos
        for blk in self.blocks:
            h = blk(h)
        h = self.nf(h)
        f = h.transpose(1, 2).reshape(B, D, Y, X)
        place = self.head(f)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([h.mean(1), h.amax(1)], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"lr": 0.001, "n_envs": 128, "rollout_len": 32, "n_minibatches": 32, "ppo_epochs": 2, "ent_coef": 0.005, "gamma": 0.98, "gae_lambda": 0.95}

STEM = 64
COL = 48
WIDTH = 40
PROJ = 32
HID = 32
DH = 256


class PoolHead(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, footprints, proj, hid):
        super().__init__()
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in footprints]
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(c, proj, 1)
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(3 * proj, hid, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(hid, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])

    def forward(self, f):
        p = self.proj(f)
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix, out in zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.outs):
            if dy * dx == 1:
                mx, mn, av = p, p, p
            else:
                q = F.pad(p, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            h = F.relu(mix(torch.cat([mx, mn, av], dim=1)))
            res.append(out(h))
        return torch.cat(res, dim=1).flatten(1)


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        Y = int(spec.Y)
        X = int(spec.X)
        self.nt = int(spec.n_types)
        self.nplace = int(spec.n_place)
        cin = int(spec.in_channels) + self.nt
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(cin, STEM, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(STEM, COL, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(COL, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.head = PoolHead(WIDTH, spec.footprints, PROJ, HID)
        dc = max(2, min(16, 1024 // (Y * X)))
        self.dproj = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, dc, 1)
        self.dfc = nn.Linear(dc * Y * X, DH)
        self.dout = nn.Linear(DH, self.nplace)
        nn.init.orthogonal_(self.dout.weight, 0.01)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.dout.bias)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * WIDTH, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        B, C, Y, X = obs.shape
        m = mask[:, :self.nplace].to(obs.dtype).reshape(B, self.nt, Y, X)
        s = self.stem(torch.cat([obs, m], dim=1))
        x = F.relu(self.c1(s))
        f = F.relu(x + self.c2(x))
        dense = self.dout(F.relu(self.dfc(F.relu(self.dproj(f)).flatten(1))))
        place = self.head(f) + dense
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):

        self.n1 = nn.LayerNorm(H)
        self.l2 = nn.Linear(H, H)
        self.l3 = nn.Linear(H, H)
        self.pi = nn.Linear(H, na)
        nn.init.orthogonal_(self.pi.weight, 0.01)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.pi.bias)
        self.v = nn.Linear(H, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        x = torch.cat([obs.flatten(1), mask.to(obs.dtype)], dim=1)
        h = F.relu(self.n1(self.l1(x)))
        h = F.relu(h + self.l2(h))
        h2 = F.relu(self.l3(h))
        return self.pi(h2), self.v(h2).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"lr": 0.001, "n_envs": 256, "rollout_len": 16, "n_minibatches": 16, "ppo_epochs": 1, "ent_coef": 0.005, "gamma": 0.98, "gae_lambda": 0.95}

STEM = 64
COL = 48
WIDTH = 40
DH = 384


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        Y = int(spec.Y)
        X = int(spec.X)
        self.nt = int(spec.n_types)
        self.nplace = int(spec.n_place)
        cin = int(spec.in_channels) + self.nt
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(cin, STEM, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(STEM, COL, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(COL, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        dc = max(2, min(16, 1024 // (Y * X)))
        self.dproj = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, dc, 1)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * WIDTH, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.dfc = nn.Linear(dc * Y * X + 64, DH)
        self.dout = nn.Linear(DH, self.nplace)
        nn.init.orthogonal_(self.dout.weight, 0.01)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.dout.bias)
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        B, C, Y, X = obs.shape
        m = mask[:, :self.nplace].to(obs.dtype).reshape(B, self.nt, Y, X)
        s = self.stem(torch.cat([obs, m], dim=1))
        x = F.relu(self.c1(s))
        f = F.relu(x + self.c2(x))
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        d = torch.cat([F.relu(self.dproj(f)).flatten(1), g], dim=1)
        place = self.dout(F.relu(self.dfc(d)))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"lr": 0.001, "n_envs": 256, "rollout_len": 16, "n_minibatches": 16, "ppo_epochs": 1, "ent_coef": 0.01, "gamma": 0.98, "gae_lambda": 0.95}

STEM = 64
COL = 48
W = 40
PROJ = 24
HID = 24
DH = 256
GH = 64


def anchor_pools(p, dy, dx):
    outs = [p]
    for a, b in ((dy, dx), (dx, dy)):
        for pad in ((0, b - 1, 0, a - 1), (b - 1, 0, a - 1, 0)):
            q = F.pad(p, pad)
            outs.append(F.max_pool2d(q, (a, b), stride=1))
            outs.append(F.avg_pool2d(q, (a, b), stride=1))
    return torch.cat(outs, dim=1)


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        Y = int(spec.Y)
        X = int(spec.X)
        self.nt = int(spec.n_types)
        self.nplace = int(spec.n_place)
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in spec.footprints]
        cin = int(spec.in_channels) + self.nt
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(cin, STEM, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(STEM, COL, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(COL, W, 3, padding=1)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(W, W, 3, padding=1)
        self.c3 = nn.Conv2d(W, W, 3, padding=2, dilation=2)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * W, GH), nn.ReLU())
        self.bcast = nn.Linear(GH, W)
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(W, PROJ, 1)
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(9 * PROJ, HID, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(HID, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        dc = max(2, min(16, 1024 // (Y * X)))
        self.dproj = nn.Conv2d(W, dc, 1)
        self.dfc = nn.Linear(dc * Y * X + GH, DH)
        self.dout = nn.Linear(DH, self.nplace)
        nn.init.orthogonal_(self.dout.weight, 0.01)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.dout.bias)
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(GH, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(GH, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        B, C, Y, X = obs.shape
        m = mask[:, :self.nplace].to(obs.dtype).reshape(B, self.nt, Y, X)
        s = self.stem(torch.cat([obs, m], dim=1))
        x = F.relu(self.c1(s))
        x = F.relu(x + self.c2(x))
        x = F.relu(x + self.c3(x))
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([x.mean((2, 3)), x.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        f = F.relu(x + self.bcast(g).unsqueeze(-1).unsqueeze(-1))
        p = self.proj(f)
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix, out in zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.outs):
            res.append(out(F.relu(mix(anchor_pools(p, dy, dx)))))
        place = torch.cat(res, dim=1).flatten(1)
        d = torch.cat([F.relu(self.dproj(f)).flatten(1), g], dim=1)
        place = place + self.dout(F.relu(self.dfc(d)))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

analyses.1: There is no evidence yet. The starting architecture scored 0.000 on both seeds. With the default recipe it gets only about 32 PPO updates of 4,096 steps each, which is likely too few for a 257-way action space where success requires every step of a long episode to be right. I see two likely bottlenecks. (1) Sample budget: dropping PPO to 1 or 2 epochs gives about 1.8 to 3.3 times as many environment steps, and smaller batches give many more updates. (2) Perception: a placement is correct only if the layer the brick lands on matches missing target cells at that height for every cell it covers, with no gaps below. A flat 2D trunk has to learn this cross-layer comparison implicitly. A shared per-layer network that scores each (brick, anchor, layer) and then combines layers with logsumexp encodes that structure directly. Candidate 1 isolates the recipe. Candidates 2 and 3 test the per-layer network under two recipes.
analyses.2: All four runs score exactly 0, including the starting architecture, and train_success_last10pct is also 0. So even the stochastic training policy never finishes an exact build, and none of the main results has told us anything yet. One thing stands out: the round-1 recipes made fewer gradient steps than the default (about 1.4k–1.8k against about 4.1k), so 'more samples' was mixed up with 'fewer updates'. The gamma of 0.95 also weakens the +1 exact-build bonus, which is the only signal that separates exact builds from sloppy ones. This round keeps one shared recipe: 2 epochs, 128 envs × 32 rollout, 32 minibatches of 128 (about 3.6k gradient steps), gamma 0.98, lambda 0.95. It tests that recipe on the starting network, on a global-attention network over cells, and on a deeper residual CNN with a whole-grid receptive field. Any score clearly above 0 is informative.
analyses.3: All six trials score exactly 0 on dev and 0 on training success. That covers recipe changes (1 to 2 epochs, 150k to 370k steps, longer horizon) and several architectures (CNN, layer-lifted scorer, transformer, dilated CNN). Seed noise cannot produce six identical zeros, even in training. Every trial shares one structural assumption: the score for action index t*Y*X + y*X + x is computed at feature-map cell (y,x), with top-left footprint pooling. If this world decodes actions differently (anchors transposed or offset, footprints swapped, a different type order), every equivariant head gets the cell-to-action mapping wrong and cannot learn. This round therefore tests heads that learn any action mapping: a dense head added to the starting architecture's pooling head, a pure MLP, and a dense-only head with the most samples the budget allows. The legal-action mask is also used as an input, because it reveals where each brick type actually fits.
analyses.4: All 9 trials scored exactly 0, on dev and on training success, across every architecture and recipe tried: a pool-head CNN, a layer-lifted net, a transformer, a dilated CNN, dense heads and a pure MLP. The recipe changes covered more updates, more samples, 1 or 2 PPO epochs and a longer horizon. Train success is also 0, so this is not overfitting: the agent never learns to finish builds at all. The dense heads and the MLP also failed, so a hidden mismatch between actions and cells is not clearly the cause, though their weaker priors may simply learn too slowly. Untested so far: a head that is robust to anchor conventions while staying translation-equivariant, high entropy (most trials used 0.005, so the policy may have collapsed onto DONE or a bad mode), and conservative small-step updates. In this last round, one network is tested under three recipes so that any nonzero result can be traced to the recipe.
